headline: Bank of America Admits to Willful Laundering Lapses, Receives $750 Million Bundle Discount on Record Fine
deck: Regulators billed the bank $1.21 billion net over $5 billion in late laundering alerts and 475 sanctions lapses. Zero executives were charged.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: $1.21B corporate civil settlement after $750M inter-agency credit; zero executives charged or indicted.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Structuring $18,000 in cash deposits to evade bank reporting rules
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: 18–30 months federal prison + full civil asset forfeiture
